task.description: WF-02 Step 5 (release validation) for REQ-039 -- independently re-verify all 9 acceptance criteria, the returning-guest fix, scope discipline, and re-run lint/build/tests myself rather than trusting prior gate reports.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism run twice from repo root, 420/420 both times
Each of GitHub issue #71's 9 ACs independently re-checked against actual code, not history narration
Returning-guest fix (host notification + attribution on the direct-redemption branch) independently traced
Scope discipline confirmed: companionProfile defaults to null, REQ-038 tests unmodified, zero schema/migration changes, single attribution mechanism

result.summary:
Independently re-ran every check from a clean read of the actual code, not the prior gate reports.

COMMANDS RE-RUN MYSELF:
- `npm run lint -w apps/bot` -> `eslint .`, zero output, clean.
- `npm run build -w apps/bot` -> `tsc -p tsconfig.json`, zero output, clean.
- Scratch Postgres (bot-postgres-1) confirmed running; `DATABASE_URL=... npx drizzle-kit migrate` applied cleanly (no new migration, matches design's stated zero-schema-change claim).
- `npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism` run twice from repo root: attempt 1 -> 46 files / 420 tests passed, 60.07s; attempt 2 -> 46 files / 420 tests passed, 56.87s. Both green, matching TEST-RUNNER's count.

INDEPENDENT AC-BY-AC RE-VERIFICATION (read the actual source, not the design doc's claims about it):

AC1 (invited_by_user_id/invite_code_id attribution): read apps/bot/src/domain/inviteCode.ts:783-828 directly -- both the update and insert branches of the registrations write set `invitedByUserId: codeRow.grantsCompanionOf` unconditionally (not gated on companionProfile), and `inviteCodeId: codeRow.id` is set on both. Confirmed against companionRedeem.db.test.ts's AC1 describe block (line 154) which reads the row back and asserts both fields directly. PASS.

AC2 (no second attribution mechanism): ran `git diff master...HEAD -- apps/bot/src/db/schema.ts` myself -- empty. Ran `git grep -n "referral|companion_id|referredBy|referred_by" -- apps/bot/src` myself -- zero matches outside test files. No new migration files in the diff stat. PASS.

AC3 (consent-before-storage, S1) -- SPOT-CHECKED IN FULL per task brief: read handlers/start.ts:203-249 line by line myself. Consent gate (`if (!hasConsented) { show prompt; return; }`) runs BEFORE any `getInviteCodeByCode`/`getProfileByUserId` call -- confirmed the companion-code lookup (line 234) is textually and behaviorally after the consent-gate return, not before it. For a guest who abandons before tapping consent:agree, the ONLY write is `resolveOrCreateUser`'s pre-existing bare users row (tg_id/tg_username/lang, no PII) from platform-level /start handling -- this predates REQ-039 and is correctly excluded from AC3's spirit as SECURITY-REVIEWER's step-02c handoff already reasoned (users table has no PII column to carry a name/phone/company at all -- confirmed myself against schema.ts's users table definition, which has no such columns). Read companion.db.test.ts's AC3 describe block (lines 329-381) myself: both cases (abandon before consent, abandon after consent but before replying with fields) assert profileCount===0 and registrationCount===0 with real row-count queries against a guest never seen before (fresh tgId), exactly matching the AC's own required construction ("a run that reaches consent before abandoning does not exercise this and is not evidence" -- the second test case explicitly covers this harder case too). Also traced makeCompanionTextReplyHandler (companion.ts:88-148) and makeCompanionConfirmCallbackHandler (companion.ts:154-226) myself: no db.insert/db.update call appears anywhere in either function outside the single `redeemInviteCode` call at the confirm step -- the field-collection conversation writes nothing. PASS, independently re-derived, not copied from the design or SECURITY-REVIEWER's trace.

AC4 (name/phone/company only): read companion.ts's field-collection path and the i18n catalog entries (companion.missingName/missingPhone/confirmButtonLabel) myself -- no experience-level/student/links prompt exists anywhere in this diff's new code or catalog strings. PASS.

AC5 (full event -> waitlisted): read inviteCode.ts:744-759 myself -- `decideRegistrationOutcome` is called with the same seatsLeft/inviteSatisfied:true shape as every other code kind; confirmed `domain/registration.ts` is untouched by this diff (`git diff --stat` shows no entry for it). Read companionRedeem.db.test.ts's AC5 block (capacity 1, pre-filled, companion redemption -> waitlisted) myself. PASS.

AC6 (single-use): read validateInviteCodeForRedemption's unchanged usedCount>=maxUses "spent" branch and companionRedeem.db.test.ts's AC6 block (guestA succeeds, used_count->1; guestB's attempt on the same code -> invite-code-spent, zero registration/profile for guestB) myself. PASS.

AC7 (S3 host-notification bounds) -- SPOT-CHECKED IN FULL per task brief: read `getCompanionDisplayData` (inviteCode.ts:1043-1070) myself -- its SELECT clause lists only firstName, lastName, tgUsername, company; profiles.phone and profiles.email are not selected at all, so the returned CompanionDisplayData interface ({displayName, company}) is structurally incapable of carrying either, not just filtered at render time. Read companion.ts's sendCompanionHostNotification composeMessage closure (lines 60-78) myself -- it interpolates only {name} and {company} into catalog.companion.hostNotification. Read the actual catalog strings myself (i18n/en.ts:393, i18n/ru.ts:403) -- no {phone}/{email} placeholder in either language. Read companion.db.test.ts's AC7 test (lines 500-550) myself in full: it seeds a RETURNING guest with a real phone (+998909998877) AND a real email on file, drives the returning-guest direct-redemption branch, and asserts the host's captured message both `.toContain` name/company and `.not.toContain` the exact phone and email strings -- this is a materially strong test since it uses a guest who actually has both values set, not a guest who happens to lack them. Also confirmed exactly-one-message-each via `guestMessages.length===1` and `sent.length===1` assertions. PASS.

AC8 (no phone in logs/audit): grepped inviteCode.ts, companion.ts, start.ts, notification.ts, profile.ts myself for console./logger./log( -- zero matches. Confirmed writeAuditLog's payload (inviteCode.ts:863) is `{ eventId, inviteCodeId }` only -- no profile field. PASS.

AC9 (exactly one audit_log row): read the unchanged single writeAuditLog call inside redeemInviteCode's transaction myself, and companionRedeem.db.test.ts's AC9 block (successful redemption -> 1 row; refused/spent redemption -> 0 rows) myself. PASS.

RETURNING-GUEST FIX -- independently re-traced (not just re-read the design's claim): handlers/start.ts:238 routes to field-collection ONLY when `isCompanionCode && codeRow !== null && existingProfile === null`; a returning guest (existingProfile !== null) falls through to the unconditional `redeemInviteCode(..., companionProfile: null)` call at line 256, which still sets invitedByUserId unconditionally (§5 point 3, confirmed above), and the host-notification block at lines 285-294 fires for this branch too (guarded on sender!==null, isCompanionCode, a writing outcome, and a returned registrationId -- all present in the normal case). This is exactly what companion.db.test.ts's AC7 test and the separate 'Returning guest' describe block (line 605) exercise. Confirmed the race backstop independently: profile.ts's createWalkinProfile call site at inviteCode.ts:783-794 passes `{ onConflictDoNothing: true }`, and this is the ONLY call site passing that option -- REQ-030's own commitWalkin call site (grepped separately) passes no options, so its behavior is unchanged. PASS.

SCOPE DISCIPLINE -- confirmed myself, not taken from any report: (1) `redeemInviteCode`'s companionProfile parameter defaults to `null` (inviteCode.ts:636: `companionProfile: CompanionProfileInput | null = null`), and handlers/registration.ts's typed /redeem handler (grepped) does not pass it at all, relying on the default -- zero behavior change for that existing caller. (2) REQ-038's own test files (inviteCode.db.test.ts, registration.db.test.ts) show no diff in `git diff master...HEAD --stat` for those paths -- genuinely unmodified. (3) `git diff master...HEAD -- apps/bot/src/db/schema.ts` is empty and no migration file was added -- zero schema/migration changes, confirmed directly, not inferred. (4) `git grep` for referral/companion_id/referredBy patterns across apps/bot/src returns zero matches outside generated test files -- invited_by_user_id is genuinely the only attribution mechanism.

ISS-0032 (typed /redeem gap) reviewed: this is a genuine, correctly-scoped-out gap (a companion code redeemed via the typed /redeem command skips the field-collection UX and host notification for a profile-less guest, but attribution and consent-gating are unaffected on that path per SECURITY-REVIEWER's independent trace, which I did not re-derive myself since it is not one of the 9 ACs and REQ-039's own issue text scopes itself to the i_<code> deep link only). Concur this is MINOR, correctly filed, and not a blocker.

No defects found. No rework needed. This requirement is ready to merge.
